meta.title: DevCity · Joey Oosenbrug
meta.description: The CV and GitHub activity of Joey Oosenbrug, rendered as an explorable 3D city.

header.theme: Switch to {theme, select, light {light} other {dark}} theme

common.hint: drag to pan · right-drag to rotate · scroll to zoom · click a building

skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: Every skill on my CV is a building. The taller it is, the more years I have used it in real projects.
skills.notTied: On my CV, but not tied to a specific role, so it gets the minimum height.

career.title: Career
career.intro: My career as a boulevard. Time runs left to right: work on one side, education and training on the other. A building is as long as the job lasted and as tall as the number of technologies I used there.

repos.title: My repos
repos.intro: Each of my public repositories is a district and each of its languages a building. Footprint is the share of the code, height grows with the number of commits. Smog hangs over repos nobody has pushed to in a while.
repos.exploreRepo: Explore this repo file by file

anyRepo.title: Any repo
anyRepo.intro: Type any public GitHub repository and walk through it. Top-level folders are districts, nested folders are blocks, files are buildings: the bigger the file, the taller the building.
anyRepo.label: GitHub repository
anyRepo.notFound: {repo} does not exist or is private.
anyRepo.rateLimited: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, or revisit a repo you opened before: those come from the cache.
anyRepo.resetsIn: resets in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
anyRepo.truncated: This repository is very large. The city shows the part GitHub returned within the request budget.
anyRepo.omitted: {count, plural, one {# small file is} other {# small files are}} left out to keep the city fast.
anyRepo.empty: Pick a repository to build its city.
